producer.tap_contract: Gemma4TextModel.layers_to_capture appends the pre-layer hidden state at indices 45 and 54 and the post-layer-60, pre-final-norm state at index 60. Gemma4ForCausalLM.capture_aux_hidden_states passes those tensors unchanged into LogitsProcessor.forward.
producer.layout: contiguous BF16 row-major after project capture copy

draft_head.causal_mixer: one shared rank-256, 8-head causal SDPA block with a 4x MLP

tied_consumer.full_output_dtype: FP32 after the stock BF16 projection boundary
tied_consumer.draft_decision: stable greedy top-1; chunked projection is allowed only when it preserves the full batched consumer's argmax

acceptance.greedy_boundary: verify_tree_greedy consumes target logits and draft candidates
acceptance.sampling_boundary: non-greedy verification requires the unchanged full target distribution and RNG path

kv_commit.contract: Rejected speculative cache slots are freed; out_cache_loc is compacted to accepted indices; only then do seq_lens, seq_lens_cpu, and seq_lens_sum advance by bonus-inclusive num_accept_tokens.
